lessons.key: ac_gap::when a task implements a function required to run at startup or on a lifecycle hook verify the composition root main go di actually calls it a passing unit test on the function alone does not prove it s wired into the running service
lessons.text: When a task implements a function required to run 'at startup' or on a lifecycle hook, verify the composition root (main.go/di) actually calls it — a passing unit test on the function alone does not prove it's wired into the running service.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when an acceptance criterion names a specific documentation file to record a known limitation in treat that file update as part of the done when checklist not an implicit side effect of the code change
lessons.text: When an acceptance criterion names a specific documentation file to record a known limitation in, treat that file update as part of the Done-when checklist, not an implicit side effect of the code change.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when an ac requires both a metric and a trace span for the same event use a real in memory span recorder in tests not a no op tracer so the span half of the requirement is actually asserted not just the metric half
lessons.text: When an AC requires both a metric and a trace span for the same event, use a real in-memory span recorder in tests, not a no-op tracer, so the span half of the requirement is actually asserted, not just the metric half.
